title: HELIX Employee Resource
description: An employee / worker — the core HR identity. Links to a HELIX Person (a single human may be both Employee and Student). Carries hire/termination, worker type, FTE, FLSA, citizenship/visa, and contact info. SSN/national ID tokenized at silver.

helix_id.description: HELIX-assigned unique identifier for this Employee record.

person_ref.description: Link to HELIX Person resource. May be the same person as a Student (student employees, GAs).

national_id.description: Tokenize at silver layer. Display last 4 only.

visa_type.description: If non-citizen: H-1B, J-1, F-1/OPT, TN, etc.

ethnicity.description: Map to HELIX ethnicity terminology. IPEDS/EEO category.

original_hire_date.description: If rehire, the first-ever hire date. Important for benefits eligibility and seniority.

continuous_service_date.description: Date for service-based calculations (vacation accrual, retirement vesting).

termination_date.description: Null if active. Cast to ISO 8601 if terminated.

termination_reason.description: Map: 'Voluntary - Resignation' → 'resignation', 'Voluntary - Retirement' → 'retirement', 'Involuntary - Termination' → 'involuntary', 'End of Contract' → 'contract_end', 'Deceased' → 'deceased'.

worker_type.description: Map: 'Employee' → 'employee', 'Contingent Worker' → 'contingent'. Bound to HELIX terminology: helix/worker-type.

flsa_status.description: Map: 'Exempt' → 'exempt', 'Non-Exempt' → 'non_exempt'. Bound to HELIX terminology: helix/flsa-status.

employment_status.description: Map: 'Active' → 'active', 'Terminated' → 'terminated', 'Leave of Absence' → 'leave', 'Suspended' → 'suspended', 'Retired' → 'retired'. Bound to HELIX terminology: helix/employment-status.

meta.description: HELIX metadata block — present on every resource.
